questions.q:
Who among the following is not awarded with ‘Bharat
Ratna’?
questions.explanation:
Among the following Pandit Jasraj is not awarded the 'Bharat
Ratna'. Ustad Bismillah Khan and Lata Mangeshkar were
awarded the "Bharat Ratna" in 2001 and Pandit Ravishankar
was awarded the award in 1999.
questions.reason: Source option labels are corrupted in the PDF text layer: printed as '(c) Lata Mangeshkar (b) Pandit Jasraj / (c) Pandit Ravishankar (d) Ustad Bismillah Khan' — option (a) is missing, option (c) is duplicated, and the labels are out of order, so the answer key (b) cannot be mapped to an unambiguous A–D option set.
questions.type_detail: Direct single-answer question phrased negatively: pick the option that is NOT correct/true/applicable (exception-type question).
